concept: EC2 instance families: memory optimized for in-memory workloads
tests: Choosing an instance family by resource profile (RAM/vCPU).
expected: Memory optimized (R/X). Triggers: "in-memory analytics/databases", "highest RAM-to-vCPU ratio".
why_not: C focuses on CPU; I on local NVMe IOPS; T is burstable with a low CPU baseline and modest memory.
